title: Rescale-Symmetric 3D
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Input Layer Normalizations/Rescale_Symmetric_3D.md
text: 3-D input layer with rescale-symmetric normalization, 1 input, 1 output, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Layer} sets the corresponding layer object, {Data format} sets the format of input, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Min} sets the data type of minimum value, {Max} sets the data type of maximum value, {Divide output} sets the data type of division output and {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Layer
params.values: Corresponding layer object layerObject (default) | image3dInputLayer object

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Keep MSB | Inherit: Keep LSB | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as accumulator |

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Min
params.values: Data type of minimum value Inherit: Inherit via back propagation (default) | Inherit: Inherit from ’Constant value’ |

params.name: Max
params.values: Data type of maximum value Inherit: Inherit via back propagation (default) | Inherit: Inherit from ’Constant value’ |

params.name: Divide output
params.values: Data type of division output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Keep MSB | Inherit: Match scaling | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input |

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar
